title: SDLC harness - audit trail
description: Starting point to fork (T447). Reads audit.db written by `metrics.py --export sqlite`; columns: docs/metrics-columns.md. Unmeasured values are NULL, never 0 - panels sum only what was reported.

panels.title: Runs by project, owner and criticality

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT project, owner, criticality, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN closed_status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed FROM runs GROUP BY project, owner, criticality ORDER BY runs DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT project, owner, criticality, COUNT(*) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN closed_status = 'closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed FROM runs GROUP BY project, owner, criticality ORDER BY runs DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT gate, COUNT(*) AS decisions, ROUND(AVG(waited_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_wait_s, ROUND(MAX(waited_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS max_wait_s FROM gates WHERE event = 'gate_decided' AND waited_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gate ORDER BY avg_wait_s DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT gate, COUNT(*) AS decisions, ROUND(AVG(waited_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_wait_s, ROUND(MAX(waited_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS max_wait_s FROM gates WHERE event = 'gate_decided' AND waited_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY gate ORDER BY avg_wait_s DESC

panels.title: Tokens and cost by model (reported steps only)

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT provider, model, steps, steps_reporting, tokens_input, tokens_output, cost_amount FROM models ORDER BY tokens_input DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT provider, model, steps, steps_reporting, tokens_input, tokens_output, cost_amount FROM models ORDER BY tokens_input DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT step_name, COUNT(*) AS attempts, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_s, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'advanced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS advanced, SUM(CASE WHEN tokens_source = 'unavailable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tokens_unmeasured FROM steps GROUP BY step_name ORDER BY attempts DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT step_name, COUNT(*) AS attempts, ROUND(AVG(duration_ms) / 1000.0, 1) AS avg_s, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'advanced' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS advanced, SUM(CASE WHEN tokens_source = 'unavailable' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tokens_unmeasured FROM steps GROUP BY step_name ORDER BY attempts DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT from_step || ' -> ' || to_step AS loop, COUNT(*) AS times FROM loop_backs GROUP BY from_step, to_step ORDER BY times DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT from_step || ' -> ' || to_step AS loop, COUNT(*) AS times FROM loop_backs GROUP BY from_step, to_step ORDER BY times DESC

targets.rawQueryText: SELECT approver, SUM(CASE WHEN decision = 'approve' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved, SUM(CASE WHEN decision = 'reject' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, SUM(CASE WHEN forced THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS forced FROM gates WHERE event = 'gate_decided' GROUP BY approver ORDER BY approved DESC
targets.queryText: SELECT approver, SUM(CASE WHEN decision = 'approve' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS approved, SUM(CASE WHEN decision = 'reject' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected, SUM(CASE WHEN forced THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS forced FROM gates WHERE event = 'gate_decided' GROUP BY approver ORDER BY approved DESC
